_prompt: the app's own mark: one membrane, one fold, no ornament — minimal but grown, not drawn
_form: a single sheet with few, deep folds. Everything that makes the organism busy at small sizes is turned off: no ribbon, no ruffle, no veins, no grain, almost no flutter
_material: dense enough to read as one silhouette at 16 pixels, with the fold catching light so it is not a flat blob
_colour: the studio's own two hues, indigo into blush, kept deep so a pale ground can carry it
_ground: paper, almost flat: an icon needs one figure and no second subject
_frame: still, and sized to sit inside a squircle rather than bleed out of it
